subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Did you update the minimum value in randint(min, max) so that the ice cream sprite only appears on the right half the screen?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What property should be used as the minimum value randomly selected as the ice cream sprite’s x position?


Solution: 

width should be added as the property in line 49, so that the code reads: iceCreamSprite.x = randint(screen.width / 2, screen.width)
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 49: an identifier was expected.



Fix the bugs in the code so that every 500 ms, an ice cream sprite appears on the right side of the screen.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Did you place the info.player2.changeScoreBy function for player 2 into the onUpdateInterval loop?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where should player 2’s changeScoreBy function be placed so that the score changes every 500 ms?


Solution: 

info.player2.changeScoreBy(1) should be cut and pasted inside the curly brackets of the onUpdateInterval loop.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, player 2’s score only increases once. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that player 2’s score increases each time a new ice cream sprite appears on the screen.

subgroups.title: Debugging Screen Positions and Multiplayer Score

text.main.ts:
// set up
scene.setBackgroundColor(9)
info.player1.setScore(0)
info.player2.setScore(0)

// player 1 (human)
controller.A.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    let donutSprite = sprites.create(img`
        . . . . . . b b b b a a . . . .
        . . . . b b d d d 3 3 3 a a . .
        . . . b d d d 3 3 3 3 3 3 a a .
        . . b d d 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 a .
        . b 3 d 3 3 3 3 3 b 3 3 3 3 a b
        . b 3 3 3 3 3 a a 3 3 3 3 3 a b
        b 3 3 3 3 3 a a 3 3 3 3 d a 4 b
        b 3 3 3 3 b a 3 3 3 3 3 d a 4 b
        b 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 d a 4 4 e
        a 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 d a 4 4 4 e
        a 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 d d a 4 4 4 e .
        a a 3 3 3 d d d a a 4 4 4 e e .
        . e a a a a a a 4 4 4 4 e e . .
        . . e e b b 4 4 4 4 b e e . . .
        . . . e e e e e e e e . . . . .
        . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
    `, SpriteKind.Player)
    donutSprite.x = randint(0, screen.width / 2)
    donutSprite.y = randint(0, screen.height)
    info.player1.changeScoreBy(1)
})

// player 2 (computer)
game.onUpdateInterval(200, function () {
    let iceCreamSprite = sprites.create(img`
        . . . . . 3 3 b 3 3 d d 3 3 . .
        . . . . 3 1 1 d 3 d 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . . . 3 d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 d 3 1 3
        . . 3 d d 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 3 3 3

        . 3 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 d 1 1 3 .
        . b d 1 1 1 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 .
        . 4 b 1 1 1 1 d d 1 1 1 1 d 3 .
        . 4 4 d 1 1 1 1 1 1 d d d b b .
        . 4 d b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 d d 5 b d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 3 . .
        4 5 d 5 5 b b d 1 1 1 1 d 3 . .

    `, SpriteKind.Player)
    iceCreamSprite.x = randint(screen.width / 2, screen.width)
    iceCreamSprite.y = randint(0, screen.height)
})
info.player2.changeScoreBy(1)

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 3 of Blue Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about block statements. In JavaScript, instead of adding code into different containers, you’ll add block statements inside curly brackets { } of an event or a loop. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 3:

badges.title: Thinking Inside the Block
badges.description: Use block statements inside curly brackets { } to add code inside of events and loops.

badges.title: Projectile Manager
badges.description: Create a  projectile in JavaScript.

badges.title: Game On (Update Interval)
badges.description: Use a game update loop in JavaScript.

badges.title: About Yay High
badges.description: Use the screen object’s height property instead of a number.

badges.title: Framing the Discussion
badges.description: Use setDialogFrame to design a custom text box.

badges.title: Settle the Score
badges.description: Set the score in JavaScript.

badges.title: Cute as a Button
badges.description: Use a button event in JavaScript.
